verdict.rationale: INPI runs an IP open-data portal, so issuing API credentials to an agent is a fair question to ask. The only relevant evidence is a probe showing that keyless access to data.inpi.fr returns 403 and that an account-issued token is required. Nothing in the pack shows that these tokens can be scoped, limited to least privilege, or issued separately for an agent, and plain token issuance is only an adjacent capability.
